title: Rangers Superheros
description: A Palladium Addon That Adds A Handful Of Superpowers.
body:
# **This Addon Adds Some Random Superheros That Are Pretty Much Ripoffs Of Popular Heros Across Fiction!**


> Ever Wanted A Pretty Terrible Mod That Adds Some Superheros?
> No? Too Bad, Because This Mod Is Exactly That!
> 
___________________________
 

(Some powers arent obtainable in survival yet)

## Currently Adds:
- 3 Different Super Suits,
- Golem Power,
- Shade Power,
- Spider Power,
- Speedster Power,
- Cheeselander Power,
- Multiverse Power (not done yet)
- Enhanced Human Power
_________________________

### **DEPENDENCIES**
- Apothic Attributes
- CoreWithStuff
- Curios Api
- Dampened
- Gravestone Core
- MoreJs
- Palladium
- Time Stop Clock
